date_note: The IANS report is dated 24 November and gives no earlier arrest date; it says the complaint was made on 6 June and the e-FIR registered on 2 July 2026.
exec: Delhi Police report arrests in a crypto fraud in which a trader's wallet was emptied through a phishing link sent by a fake buyer.
org: Delhi Police (South-West District Cyber Police Station)
plain: Delhi Police say they arrested four people accused of tricking a crypto trader on Binance peer-to-peer into clicking a phishing link and losing 4,985 USDT. Police say the money was refunded to the trader.

sources.name: Prokerala (IANS): Delhi Police busts cryptocurrency fraud syndicate targeting traders through phishing links; four arrested
WebIndia123: Delhi Police bust cryptocurrency fraud syndicate, 4 arrested for cheating trader of Rs 5 lakh

evidence.quote: The entire cheated amount of 4,985 USDT, approximately Rs 5 lakh, has also been refunded to the complainant.

summary: Delhi Police said they arrested four people over a cryptocurrency fraud on Binance peer-to-peer traders. According to the police account relayed by IANS, a fake buyer sent a phishing link to a trader and drained 4,985 USDT (approximately Rs 5 lakh) from the wallet; police said the amount was refunded to the complainant. Police are still examining transaction records.
title: Delhi Police arrest four over Binance P2P phishing fraud that took 4,985 USDT from a trader

validation.note: Prokerala and WebIndia123 both relay the same IANS report of the police account; treated as one publisher. The ANI page returned 403 and was not read. The police's own statement was not read.

review.note: Compared title, date, 4,985 USDT figure and quote, four arrests, refund, status against Prokerala/IANS and WebIndia123
